**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — the full orchestration. Ordered steps (each `next:` chains to the following):
`validate` (ValidateNewOwner) → `checkTelephoneUnique` (CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique) → `checkEmailUnique` (CheckOwnerEmailUnique) → `checkHouseholdUnique` (CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique) → `checkCityCapacity` → `checkDailyLimit` → `build` (BuildOwner) → `assignCustomerCode` → `assignMembershipNumber` → `assignHousehold` (AssignHousehold) → `assignNamesakeCount` → `save` (SaveOwner) → `audit` → `respond` (RespondWithOwnerCreated). All steps run under `govern: [ transaction ]`; the whole endpoint is authorized `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`.

The three duplicate checks (`checkTelephoneUnique`, `checkEmailUnique`, `checkHouseholdUnique`) run **after validation/normalization but before `build`**, so a duplicate is a 409 and nothing is persisted. Function classes live under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`.

All three iterate `ownerRepository.findAll()` and compare a normalized field, taking the `@Val OwnerFieldsDto request` published by `ValidateNewOwner`.

**`CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique.java`** — compares request's E.164 telephone against each stored owner's telephone re-normalized via `TelephoneE164.normalize` (stored values that can't form E.164 are treated as null/no-match). Throws `DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException(request.getTelephone())`.

**`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique.java`** — skips when `request.getSharesHousehold()` is TRUE. Throws `DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException(request.getLastName(), request.getAddress())`.

- `DuplicateOwnerEmailException.java` (msg: "An owner with email … already exists")

        ObjectNode b = ownerNode();

- DTOs generated in `generate-sources` from `openapi.yml` → package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, `interfaceOnly`, MapStruct + Jakarta EE.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server defaults it to the current date. The
            effective date (supplied or defaulted) must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or
            Sunday is rolled forward to the following Monday before it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only hint. When true, permits creating this owner even when
            another owner has the same last name and address (a shared household); ignored
            (defaults false) otherwise. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned membership code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased
                first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same last
                name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true
                and joins an existing same-household owner; both then share this identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived from the stored fields.
                Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and
                is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's
                registration day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored fields.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      properties:

        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:

          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30

## Summary

I consolidated the three separate owner duplicate checks (telephone, email, household) into a single derived `identityKey`.

**The key** — `normalizedTelephone + "|" + (email or empty) + "|" + householdId`:
- `normalizedTelephone`: E.164 form
- email: lower-cased, or empty when absent
- `householdId`: the owner's shared-household identifier, empty when it belongs to no shared household

Rejection is a 409 **only when a new owner's whole key equals an existing owner's**. Because telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones get different keys and are both allowed — exactly as specified.

**What I added:**
- `OwnerIdentityKey` — derives the key for a request (`forRequest`, using the household id the request *would* be assigned) and for a stored owner (`forOwner`), so the check-time key matches the saved/returned key.
- `Household` — shared household resolution/assignment, so `AssignHousehold` and the identity key use the exact same household id.
- `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique` — the single pipeline step; scans `findAll()` and throws `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` (→ 409) on a full-key match.
- `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` + handler + escalation YAML.
- `identityKey` as a read-only field on the `Owner` schema (`openapi.yml`) plus a MapStruct expression, so it's **returned** in the response.

**What I changed/removed:**
- `owners.POST.yml`: replaced `checkTelephoneUnique`/`checkEmailUnique`/`checkHouseholdUnique` with one `checkIdentityUnique` step.
- Deleted the three old check classes, their three exceptions, three handlers, and three escalation YAMLs.
- Simplified `AssignHousehold` to delegate to `Household`.

**Behaviour change (as required):** same last-name+address alone (or same email alone, or same telephone alone) no longer conflicts — only an exact full-key match does.
